methodologyNotes: Roster covers 13 cellular and non-cellular trail / game cameras. Every product re-verified 2026-06-19 against the manufacturer page plus a specialist reviewer (primarily trailcampro.com) and/or a major retailer. trigger_speed_sec is the picture-mode trigger in seconds (specialist-measured where available, else manufacturer-rated); detection_range_ft is the manufacturer-RATED PIR detection distance in feet (kept consistent across the roster rather than mixing measured and rated values); flash_type uses no_glow / low_glow / white, with red-glow / 850 nm IR mapped to low_glow per the three-value vocabulary; cellular is a boolean (true = built-in LTE radio); megapixels are the native sensor value where disclosed, else null (most models advertise interpolated MP only); priceUsd is the US MSRP or a published retail price as a number; null denotes a genuinely unverified value. Corrections this pass: spypoint-force-pro price 99.99->169.95 (the $99.99 figure was unsupported; TrailCamPro regular price is $169.95 and Spypoint MSRP is well above $99.99); bushnell-cellucore-30 trigger 0.2->0.35, detection 100->80, flash no_glow->low_glow (TrailCamPro measures 0.35 s, 80 ft, red-glow IR); stealth-cam-fusion-x-pro detection 70->80 (rated value, for methodology consistency). accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Tactacam Reveal X Gen 3.0
products.provenance: Tactacam product page and Amazon listing confirm 4K (interpolated) photo, 1080p video, low-glow IR (Tactacam branding), 12 AA batteries, GPS, 2024 launch, ~96 ft (29 m) rated range, $119.99. TrailCamPro measured 0.36 s trigger and classifies the flash as red-glow (mapped to low_glow). Native megapixels not disclosed (4K via interpolation), so megapixels=null.
